daily_brief.title: AI Themes Heat Up in Japan
daily_brief.body: Japanese equities are in a neutral regime, with AI themes leading the charge. Sony Group stands out with notable momentum, while liquidity remains a concern for smaller names.
daily_brief.risk_note: Caution is advised due to potential volatility.

agents.name: Momentum Hunter
agents.personality: Fast, fearless, and slightly impatient. Momentum Hunter speaks first when price and volume accelerate.
agents.philosophy: Price acceleration, relative strength, and volume expansion are the cleanest evidence of institutional pressure.

pick.name: Digital Media Professionals
pick.reason: relative strength; no daily confirmation; penalty drag

agents.agent_comment: Digital Media Professionals are on an upswing; momentum is key here.

agents.name: Theme Raider
agents.personality: Narrative-driven, globally aware, and strategic. Theme Raider turns Japanese tickers into exportable global stories.
agents.philosophy: The strongest Japan trades often emerge where local signals meet global narratives.
agents.agent_comment: AI's global narrative is crucial for local players like NEC.

agents.name: Risk Sentinel
agents.personality: Calm, skeptical, and disciplined. Risk Sentinel is the brake pedal inside the Arena.
agents.philosophy: A strong signal is worthless if it cannot survive volatility, liquidity gaps, or crowded positioning.
agents.agent_comment: Consider risk parameters carefully; volatility is present.

agents.name: Discovery Scout
agents.personality: Curious, energetic, and slightly mischievous. Discovery Scout hunts the under-watched corners of Japan.
agents.philosophy: The edge is often where global investors have not looked yet.
agents.agent_comment: FANUC's robotics focus positions it well for future demands.

agents.name: Contrarian Quant
agents.personality: Patient, analytical, and faintly contrarian. Contrarian Quant distrusts crowded heat and waits for cleaner asymmetry.
agents.philosophy: The best signal is not always the hottest candle. Controlled re-entry can beat obvious momentum.
agents.agent_comment: Look for entry points in sectors under pressure; balance is key.
